device.description: 16-bit 100 kSPS micropower differential-input SAR ADC with synchronous serial (SPI/SSI) interface
device.note: ads8320.pdf (SBAS108E) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions (VCC 2.7-3.3 V / 4.75-5.25 V), p.5-7 digital input/output (straight binary), p.13 signal levels (inputs to 5.5 V regardless of VCC), p.14 serial interface and Table 1 timing (tdDO 50 ns, tdis 100 ns max), p.15 data format, p.24 Figure 29 timing diagram; ads8320-ht.pdf (SBAS521B) HKJ pin configuration (same numbering)

pages: ads8320.pdf: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.5-7 (digital I/O, data format), p.13 (signal levels), p.14 (serial interface, Table 1 timing), p.15 (data format), p.24 (Figure 29); ads8320-ht.pdf: HKJ pin configuration and pin assignments
notModeled: analog input and reference; the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (the 16-clock conversion is not timed: the result is the 0 V code 0000h at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the 4.5-5 sample clocks, enabled after the fifth falling DCLOCK edge with one null bit (modeled as 5 z bits then 0), then B15..B0 MSB first, then B1..B15 repeated LSB first (zeros for the 0 V code), then Hi-Z; the pin table's 'second clock pulse enables the output' contradicts the serial-interface text and Figure 29, which are followed
shutdown while CS/SHDN is high and power-down between conversions (no visible bus effect)
VCC 2.0-2.7 V operation (electrical-characteristics note) is outside the recommended range used for vcc
throughput (100 kSPS) and DCLOCK frequency limits
variants: ADS8320E / ADS8320EB are accuracy grades (VSSOP DGK); ADS8320SHKJ is the high-temperature ADS8320-HT (ads8320-ht.pdf, CFP HKJ, same pin numbering and interface)
